criteria.criterion: workflow-a start creates missing workspace, artifact, and store parent directories or fails closed with structured path errors
criteria.evidence: _prepare_start_paths normalizes workspace_ref, artifact_dir, and store_path, then _ensure_directory creates workspace, artifacts, and store.parent. _ensure_directory raises OSError or ValueError with the offending path, and cli.main catches OSError/ValueError into a structured JSON error. The regression test asserts the missing directories are created and snapshot paths match.
